Name: HIPAA Security Rule & HITECH for OCI
Description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act standards for safeguarding electronic protected health information (ePHI).

Requirements.Name: Access Control & Unique User Identification
Requirements.Description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information.

Requirements.Name: Encryption and Decryption (Data at Rest)
Requirements.Description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information across volumes and buckets.

Requirements.Name: Audit Controls & Security Event Tracking
Requirements.Description: Implement hardware, software, and procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems.

Requirements.Name: Transmission Security & Network Boundaries
Requirements.Description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
